title: ArtifactVersion
description: One parse of one version of a source file. Separates 'file changed' (raw_hash) from 're-parsed' (parser_version) -- see Sec. A.1.

version_id.description: Identifier for this (artifact, raw content, parser) triple

raw_hash.description: SHA-256 of raw file bytes, pre-parse

parser_version.description: Version of the parser that produced this version's occurrences
